stem: Which detail about Lindbergh's flight supports the idea that he flew the plane low in the sky?

options.label: F
options.text: Lindbergh used the stars to guide him.

options.label: G
options.text: Lindbergh called out to fishermen for directions.

options.label: H
options.text: The plane traveled through poor weather conditions.

options.label: J
options.text: The plane was equipped with hundreds of gallons of fuel.
